title: Replit Agent: Features, Pricing, Credits & Alternatives

facts.fact: Replit's Starter free plan includes daily Agent credits and one published project that lasts 30 days.
facts.quote: Starter with daily Agent credits and one 30-day published project

facts.fact: The Replit Core plan costs $20 per month when billed monthly.
The Replit Core plan costs $17 per month when billed annually.
The Replit Pro plan costs $100 per month when billed monthly.
The Replit Pro plan costs $95 per month when billed annually.
Replit's Core plan supports up to 5 builders and the Pro plan supports up to 15 builders, according to the page.
facts.quote: Up to 5 builders on Core and 15 on Pro

facts.fact: Replit states that current plans support two parallel agents on Core and ten parallel agents on Pro.
facts.quote: Current plans support two parallel agents on Core and ten on Pro

facts.fact: Replit states that the Starter plan includes one published project for 30 days, while Core and Pro support unlimited published projects.
facts.quote: Starter includes one published project for 30 days, while Core and Pro support unlimited published projects with infrastructure usage billed through credits.

facts.fact: The page says it was last reviewed on August 29, 2026.
